section: 2.1 TowerBase: Extending the multilingual capabilities of LLaMA-2
quote: We extend LLaMA-2's training on a highly-multilingual dataset comprising 20 billion tokens — measured with the model's tokenizer — for 10 languages: English (en), German (de), French (fr), Dutch (nl), Italian (it), Spanish (es), Portuguese (pt), Korean (ko), Russian (ru), and Chinese (zh).
claim: Tower extends LLaMA-2's pretraining on a highly-multilingual dataset comprising 20 billion tokens for 10 languages
